text:
Cleaning rounds this weekend stayed on our minds, and it was good to get your review. We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal during travel and the worry this caused you when the service did not meet the standard you expected from Aurelia Skyways.

We take concerns like this seriously because a calm journey for both traveler and animal depends on careful preparation, clear communication, and respectful follow-through. When a passenger reaches out with a report of distress, the Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews the account with attention and keeps the focus on the animal's comfort, the handling process, and the communication you received from our team. If there was any lapse in boarding support, cabin coordination, or reassurance at the welcome stage, that is not the experience we aim to provide.

<<FACT F120>> Please keep any supporting details together for review, since clear records help us look closely at what happened and respond with care. Our supervisors are ready to listen, and we will work to trace the path of your travel record, speak with the staff involved, and determine where our process may have fallen short.

In the meantime, we ask you to share any notes about the animal's condition, the point in the journey where the concern arose, and any messages or documents that may help us assess the matter fully. We will treat your account with respect and use it to guide corrective action if needed. Where a service failure is confirmed, we aim to address it directly and to improve the guidance given to travelers with companion animals in future cases.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention and for allowing us the chance to review it carefully. We appreciate your patience while the matter is examined, and we remain committed to safer, kinder travel support across Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
